name: 龙之森林
hero: 你是一片龙栖之林。表面看似平凡，但其下正孕育着一幅足以撼动世界的宏大图景。
narrative: You're the kind of large vessel that doesn't reveal itself easily. 甲辰 is a giant tree rooted in damp earth. 辰 is the dragon's earth, and it stores water. You look unremarkable most of the time — and then at a decisive moment, your growth shows. People say later, 'Wait — that person was that person?'

Your strength is seeing the big picture. You sketch the large frame first and arrange people and resources inside it. And you don't rush. You grow heavily, slowly. That's the real strength of 甲辰 — quiet most of the time, moving the world when it counts.

Your shadow is holding the potential without releasing it. If 甲 doesn't use the water in 辰, it just stays pooled in the ground. Same for you. If you sketch a big picture but never bring it out, people don't know your potential. And over time the label 'what does that person actually do?' starts to attach.
成熟的Jia-Jin懂得从细微之处展现全局。保持气度，并通过细微的举动将其展现出来。这样，你的存在就不再令人望而生畏，反而会成为人们信赖和依靠的对象。
shadows: 只顾描绘宏大蓝图，却忽略了具体的执行细节。
拥有潜力却从不显露，因此人们会低估你。
等待那个决定性的时刻，直到它永远不会到来。
advice: 本周，将你心中的一幅宏图转化为具体的行动。
从大局中挑选一个你现在就能做的小小开端。
向别人说明一下你的计划。如果只放在心里，别人是不知道的。
别再等待那个决定性的时刻了——本周就亲手创造一个吧。
